start.title: Start
start.instruction: To start, place the device on the affected area

info.title: Info
info.aboutDescription: FERVIX is a medical device application designed to provide safe and effective treatment.
info.howItWorksDescription: The device uses advanced technology to deliver precise treatment according to medical protocols.
info.safetyInfoDescription: Please read all safety instructions before use. Consult your healthcare provider if you have any questions.

tips.title: Tips for optimal usage
tips.tip1: Ensure skin is clean and dry

faq.title: FAQ
faq.question1: How long does a treatment take?
faq.answer1: A typical treatment session takes 10-15 minutes depending on the selected profile.
faq.question2: Is the device safe for children?
faq.answer2: Yes, the device has a special child profile with reduced intensity for safe use.
faq.question3: Can I use it on sensitive skin?
faq.answer3: Yes, enable the sensitive skin mode for gentler treatment settings.
faq.question4: How often can I use the device?
faq.answer4: Follow your healthcare provider's recommendations, typically once per day maximum.

support.title: Support
support.contactDescription: Need help? Our support team is here to assist you.
support.manualDescription: Download the complete user manual for detailed instructions.
support.faqDescription: Find answers to frequently asked questions.

heating.title: Heating Phase
heating.statusDescription: Device is heating up to the required temperature. Please wait...

cooling.title: Cooling Phase
cooling.statusDescription: Device is cooling down to safe temperature. Please wait...

treatment.title: Treatment in Progress
treatment.detailsDescription: Treatment is currently in progress. Please remain still and follow the instructions.

completed.title: Treatment Completed
completed.successDescription: Your treatment has been completed successfully.

aborted.title: Treatment Aborted
aborted.stoppedDescription: The treatment was stopped before completion.
aborted.reasonDescription: Treatment was manually stopped by the user.
aborted.nextStepsDescription:
• Check the device for any issues
• Contact support if needed
• You can restart treatment when ready
